css: simulation.css
title: "The API"
---

The client packages wrap a small JSON API. You only need it directly if you want to write your own client.

- **Base address:** `https://eumel.tail81c88a.ts.net/aef`
- **Interactive documentation:** [`/__docs__/`](https://eumel.tail81c88a.ts.net/aef/__docs__/)
- **OpenAPI document:** [`/openapi.json`](https://eumel.tail81c88a.ts.net/aef/openapi.json)

Every request except `/health` and `/public/` needs your team token as a header: `Authorization: Bearer aef_...`.

## Responses

Every response has the same three fields:

```json
{"close_date": "2027-02-09", "parameter_set_id": "P1-baseline", "data": ...}
```

- `close_date` is the close the data reflects.
- `parameter_set_id` is the rule set for the next trade.
- `data` holds the result.

Errors come as `{"error": {"code": ..., "message": ...}}` with an HTTP status code. The message says what went wrong and what to do.

## Endpoints

| Method and path | Client function | What |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /health` | | Liveness check, no token needed |
| `GET /calendar` | `get_calendar()` | Trading days and their deadlines |
| `GET /universe?close_date=` | `get_universe()` | The stocks you can buy after that close, with `sp500` |
| `GET /parameters` | `get_parameters()` | All rule sets, and the next trading day |
| `POST /validate` | `validate()` | Check a submission without storing it |
| `POST /submit` | `submit()` | Submit target weights (201 accepted, 422 rejected; both are logged) |
| `DELETE /submit/{id}` | `cancel()` | Withdraw a submission before its deadline |
| `GET /submissions` | `get_submissions()` | Your submissions, newest first |
| `GET /portfolio` | `get_portfolio()` | Portfolio value, cash and positions at the latest close |
| `GET /performance` | `get_performance()` | Your daily portfolio value and statistics, with the benchmarks |
| `GET /leaderboard` | `get_leaderboard()` | Everyone under pseudonyms |
| `GET /benchmarks` | `get_benchmarks()` | Naive 1/N, buy and hold, SPY |
| `GET /public/leaderboard.json` | | The public leaderboard's data, no token needed |

A submission body:

```json
{"close_date": "2027-02-09",
 "weights": {"AAPL": 0.30, "MSFT": 0.20},
 "rationale": "12-month momentum, top 30, equal weight."}
```

It trades at the next market open whose deadline (09:00 New York time) has not passed when it arrives. `close_date` may be any close up to the one before that open.

## Error codes

Rule checks on a submission (`validate()` and `submit()`):

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `malformed_weights` | Weights are not an object of finite numbers keyed by ticker |
| `duplicate_ticker` | A ticker appears more than once |
| `invalid_close_date` | `close_date` is missing or not a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) |
| `close_date_in_future` | `close_date` is later than the close before the trade |
| `simulation_ended` | The last trading day's deadline has passed |
| `unknown_ticker` | Not a stock in the simulation |
| `ineligible_ticker` | Not in the universe that day (closed below $5), and the weight is not a hold or reduction of a current position |
| `short_not_allowed` | A negative weight while shorting is off |
| `leverage_exceeded` | Sum of absolute weights above the limit |
| `net_exposure_exceeded` | Sum of weights above the limit |
| `max_weight_exceeded` | A single weight above the limit (no such limit in 2027) |
| `too_many_positions` | More non-zero weights than allowed |
| `rationale_missing`, `rationale_too_long` | A submission needs a rationale of up to 10,000 characters |

Cancelling a submission (`cancel()`):

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `unknown_submission` | Your team has no submission with that id |
| `not_cancellable` | Already cancelled, or rejected |
| `cancel_deadline_passed` | Its trade's deadline has passed |

Requests the API refuses before any rule check:

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_json` | 400 | The body is not valid JSON |
| `invalid_close_date`, `invalid_date` | 400 | A date in the query is not `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `missing_token` | 401 | No `Authorization: Bearer` header |
| `unknown_token` | 401 | The server does not know the token |
| `not_found` | 404 | No such endpoint |
| `no_universe` | 422 | No universe for that `close_date` yet |
| `not_ready` | 503 | The data for this request is not loaded yet; try again later |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Something broke on the server; the message gives a time to quote |

The client packages add their own codes for problems they catch before sending anything, or when the server cannot be reached: `connection_failed`, `timeout`, `server_unavailable`, `http_error` and `invalid_submission_id`.
